---
name: spec
description: Draft or update an approved-scope ZeroTrace spec before code.
---
Use `zerotrace-development-loop` and `spec-driven-development`. Read `docs/DECISIONS.md`, the relevant phase gate, and only pertinent repo/wiki sources. Clarify assumptions and open choices. Write a testable spec: objective, actors, data flow, contracts, errors, security/privacy, resource limits, tests, scope/non-goals. Do not implement. Save under the existing canonical docs path; do not overwrite unrelated work. Present the exact spec diff and wait for explicit human approval in a later turn.
